title: bulbophyllum epicranthes
intro: Bulbophyllum epicranthes, commonly known as the helmet orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of the Philippines. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Bulbophyllum epicranthes include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antihypertensive properties, which have been attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
